title: CPF Module Schema: Data Lake Store module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-datalakestore'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

access_tier.description: (Optional) Defines the Access Tier for the Storage Account. • Possible values are: `Cool`, `Hot`.

account_kind.description: (Optional) Defines the Kind of account. Valid options are BlobStorage, BlockBlobStorage, FileStorage, Storage and StorageV2.

account_replication_type.description: (Optional) Defines the type of replication to use for this storage account. Valid options for Standard Storage Account are LRS, GRS, RAGRS, ZRS, GZRS and RAGZRS. GRS is not supported for Premium Storage Account.

account_tier.description: (Optional) Defines the Tier to use for this storage account. Valid options are Standard and Premium.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow access to the key vault keys.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) A customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

default_to_oauth_authentication.description: (Optional) Default to Azure Active Directory authorization in the Azure portal when accessing the Storage Account

edge_zone.description: (Optional) Specifies the Edge Zone within the Azure Region where this Storage Account should exist. Changing this forces a new Storage Account to be created.

enable_key_access.description: (Optional) If set to `false` any requests to the account that are authorized with Shared Key, including shared access signatures (SAS), will be denied.

encryption_scopes.description: (Optional) Map of the encryption scopes in the Storage Account.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

identity.description: (Required) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Storage Account. Possible values are `UserAssigned`, `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned` (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Required) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this Storage Account. This is required when `type` is set to `UserAssigned` or `SystemAssigned, UserAssigned`." })

infrastructure_encryption_enabled.description: (Optional) Determines if the Infrastruction Encryption of the storage account should be enabled or disabled.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_id.description: (Required) ID of the existing Key vault to store the Customer Managed Key for Encryption.

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

kv_secret_expiration_date.description: (Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z') for Storage Account access key Key vault Secret.

large_file_share_enabled.description: (Optional) Set to `true`, the Storage Account will be enabled for large file shares.

network_access_enabled.description: Enable or disable public network access for the storage account.

network_rules.type: object({ bypass = list(string) ip_rules = list(string) virtual_network_subnet_ids = list(string) })
network_rules.description: (Optional) A network_rules block as defined below object({ default_action = "(Required) The Default Action to use when no rules match ip_rules / virtual_network_subnet_ids. Possible values are `\"Allow\"` and `\"Deny\"`." bypass = "(Optional) Specifies whether traffic is bypassed for Logging/Metrics/AzureServices. Valid options are any combination of [`\"Logging\"`, `\"Metrics\"`, `\"AzureServices\"`, `\"None\"`]." ip_rules = "(Optional) One or more Public IP Addresses or CIDR Blocks which should be able to access the Storage Account." virtual_network_subnet_ids = "(Optional) One or more Subnet IDs which should be able to access the Storage Account." })

nfsv3_enabled.description: (Optional) Set to `true`, the `NFSV3` protocol will be enabled.

persist_access_key.description: (Optional) Set `true` to store storage access key in `key vault`.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

retention_policy_days.description: (Optional) Specifies the number of days that the containers, blob and share should be retained, the value must be between between 1 and 365.

sftp_enabled.description: (Optional) Boolean, enable SFTP for the storage account. SFTP support requires is_hns_enabled set to true. Defaults to false

smb_settings.description: (Optional) SMB settings for the storage account.

storage_policy_required.description: (Optional) Specifies whether the storage account management policy is required.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Datalakestore' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
